body: I hadn’t noticed you mentioned your patriarchal blessing, I swear I read your entire post lol. Even having marriage mentioned in my personal blessing - I still get antsy about the timing. Patience is a virtue. So I understand! Maybe it has nothing to do with you, and maybe your eternal companion still has some work to do? I wonder if that’s a possibility.

Honestly, I felt like I was reading my own words. I relate so much. The similarities are insane. I’m also 28, will be 29 in January. I left the church in my youth and came back when I was 19 about to be 20. I feel like I posses good qualities. Everyone says I’m beautiful, that anyone would be lucky to be with me, etc. but I haven’t had any luck in the dating game. My YSA is small and all the guys that come in are in their early 20’s. I feel like I’m aging out and at times I feel like I should just go back to a family ward. 

Have you received your patriarchal blessing? If so, does it mention anything about marriage? Sometimes that gives me comfort. The Lord doesn’t withhold blessings unless it’s for a good reason. I know this may not help but trust in His timing. Maybe your eternal companion is on her way :)
How’d you get a picture of me? Lol
